audio_witnesses.detail: 808 trap beat drops with skittering hi-hat rolls beneath rhythmic, pitch-shifted stereo 'Who?' and 'Can you?' call-and-response vocal ad-libs.
Vocalist abruptly snaps into an aggressive cadence on 'Fuck it, I'll do it live' followed by a brief dry beat pocket before bass re-engages.

Arrangement strips to low-pass filtered atmospheric drone pads and sub-bass; vocals drop to a deep vocoded whisper on 'Find the signal in the noise' before final trailing reverb decays to full silence.

vocal_character.voice_count: Primary male hip-hop vocal lead, accompanied by pitch-shifted doubling layers, formant-shifted stereo ad-lib tracks, and filtered low/whisper registers.
vocal_character.delivery: Rhythmic rap cadence blending conversational flow, sharp hype interjections, rhythmic repetition, and spoken/whispered philosophical asides.
vocal_character.overlap: Substantial vocal doubling and ad-lib overlay over the main lead track in hook segments and key transitions (e.g., 'CJ!', 'DOCTOR?', 'Who?').

tempo.evidence: Consistent half-time trap groove with third-beat snare/clap pattern measured across verses (approx. 150 BPM in standard double-time grid).
